phases.label: Phase 0
phases.blurb: Prove the note schema by hand, on a few pilot projects

phases.label: Phase 1
phases.blurb: Run the pipeline manually, end to end, once per format

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.blurb: Turn it into a repeatable, semi-automated process

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.blurb: Standalone script — only if volume justifies it

tasks.task: Confirm and connect the vault folder
Hand-write 3–5 sample notes across a few different pilot projects or clients
Build one Bases view over the sample notes
Confirm the view answers real lookup questions; adjust schema if not
Decide what counts as "key information" for an image (D-006)
Set up the Inbox convention (folder or note)
Draft and finalize the rule table for known Drive/Canva locations, per project and client
Test Canva connector text extraction on one real client design (D-008)
Run the pipeline manually end-to-end on one source per format
Review and correct AI-inferred categorizations from the trial run
Turn the pipeline into a repeatable checklist or prompt
Build the rule table as an editable config file
Set up a Cowork scheduled task fired on demand (optional)
Evaluate whether volume justifies a standalone script
Build standalone script calling Google/Canva/Claude APIs directly (only if triggered)

tests.validates: Every field in the note schema captures what's actually needed
The vault views return the right notes when filtered/grouped by project or client
One real source each for Google Doc, Sheet, Canva, CSV, image, text runs through the pipeline without manual fixes
Rule-matched and AI-fallback categorizations are correct on a sample of 10 sources across different projects
Re-submitting the same source updates the existing note instead of duplicating it

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.role: Source — Docs and Sheets are read directly for extraction, across any project's Drive

integrations.name: Canva
integrations.role: Source — slide decks and designs, text extraction depth still unverified (D-008)

integrations.name: Obsidian
integrations.role: Destination — the single vault every project and client writes into, queried via Bases/Dataview

integrations.name: Claude / Cowork
integrations.role: The extraction, summarization, and categorization engine that runs the pipeline

integrations.name: n8n
integrations.role: Proposed for automating the Inbox trigger — exact workflow not yet defined (D-010, open)

impact.note: These are targets this design is aiming for, not measurements — nothing has been built or tested yet. See Test Status below; validating these is part of the Phase 1 build gate.

items.before: Hunting across Drive, Canva, and chat threads for one project's facts, repeated for every new project or client
items.after: One searchable vault, filtered by project or client

items.before: Institutional knowledge lost when a project wraps, a client relationship ends, or people rotate off
items.after: Source material preserved as structured, permanent notes, no matter how many projects stack up

items.before: Compiling a project's key facts for planning or handoff takes hours — and multiplies with every new client
items.after: Target: minutes per project, once the schema and pipeline are validated

items.before: Northstar's strategy layer works from scattered, stale source material
items.after: Northstar reads clean, structured, current notes from every project at once
